changed: In a figure of your own made for English, the "other" slot of a group of dancers now has a value for four pairs of the groups only English has: the top and the bottom, the ends and the middles, the left file and the right file, and the first and second diagonals. Before, it was empty for all of them, and a wording that tests it could not tell them apart. The other groups only English has, such as the couples or the actives, still have none. A combination made for English whose parameter is bound to an opposite now accepts these groups too. The wording of an existing dance's line changes when it is next shown; an older version of the app keeps showing the line as it was.

ParamOpposites.of gives the dancerSet and dancerPair values top, bottom, ends, middles, leftFile, rightFile, firstDiagonals and secondDiagonals their opposite (_englishPairs, inside _dancerOpposite). ParamVocab.pairInverse is unchanged, and none of the eight is in ParamVocab.dancerSets, so contra, square and unknown forms are unaffected.
